findings.headline: US-Japan coordinated yen intervention — 'weaponized yen' reshaping global currency markets
findings.summary: CNBC analysis (Aug 7) calls the unprecedented US-Japan intervention a 'weaponized yen' moment that may reshape global currency markets. Yen lifted from 163 to 157. Both sides stand ready to intervene again. First joint US-Japan currency intervention since 1998. Scale exceeds previous unilateral Japanese interventions.

findings.headline: BOJ flags inflation 'clearly above 2%' from H2 FY2026 — hawkish signal for September hike
findings.summary: BOJ warned underlying inflation likely to accelerate 'clearly above' 2% from September onward. Signaling another hike as early as September. BOJ at 1% (31-year high). Japanese 2Y bond yields rose above 1.57%. Verbal intervention now hawkish — rate hike signal is domestic complement to FX intervention.

findings.headline: TBAC report: Iran conflict and energy prices 'dominant influence' on global markets
findings.summary: Treasury Borrowing Advisory Committee report states Iran conflict and energy price effects remain the dominant influence on global markets since May. Official Treasury-level acknowledgment of geopolitical market dominance.

findings.headline: Reuters: Bank formally ties money laundering concerns to president's family business — first such disclosure
findings.summary: Reuters reports a bank has for the first time formally tied money laundering concerns to the president's family business. Significant institutional disclosure that could trigger regulatory and political cascading effects.

findings.headline: ISW: Iran 'fully exploited' ceasefire to rebuild military — importing new equipment and producing new systems
findings.summary: Institute for the Study of War reports Iranian Artesh spokesperson stated Iran made 'maximum use' of ceasefire to import new equipment, repair damaged systems, and produce new systems. Iranian military establishment dominates regime decision-making against concessions.

findings.headline: Central banks struggling to get enough data on borrowers — financial stability concerns rising
findings.summary: Central Banking publication reports many central banks are struggling to get sufficient data, particularly on borrowers. Deteriorating credit visibility at systemic level — central banks flying partially blind on credit risk precisely when recession signals are building.

findings.headline: BOJ holds at 1.0% but signals September hike — Japanese 2Y yields above 1.57%
findings.summary: BOJ kept rates at 1.0% in July but minutes show two members pushed for action. BOJ signaling upside risks could justify another hike as early as September. Japanese 2Y bond yields rose above 1.57%. GDP growth projected at 0.6% for 2026.

findings.headline: ECB Economic Bulletin: outlook 'highly uncertain' — energy prices and geopolitical tensions dominate
findings.summary: ECB economic bulletin states outlook 'highly uncertain due to ongoing geopolitical tensions and increased volatility in oil prices.' Risks to growth outlook are to the downside. US-Iran MoU in June was first attempt but renewed setbacks. Geopolitical situation remains fragile.

findings.headline: Fed requests comment on modernizing insider lending rules — communication scrutiny intensifies
findings.summary: Federal Reserve Board requests comment on proposal to modernize rule governing extension of credit to bank 'insiders.' Fed communication under intense scrutiny as bond sell-off raises credibility questions.

findings.headline: Banxico holds at 6.50% through 2026-2027 — emerging market central banks in defensive hold
findings.summary: Banxico maintains overnight policy rate at 6.50%. USD/MXN trading sideways 17-18. Emerging market central banks in defensive holds amid global uncertainty.

findings.headline: Iran widening pressure campaign — Hormuz talks stall, Houthis attack Saudi oil tanker
findings.summary: Reuters reports Iran pursuing calibrated escalation — turning trade routes, shipping lanes and energy infrastructure into pressure points. Iran-Oman Hormuz deal hitting obstacles. Houthis claimed attack on Saudi oil tanker Aug 5. Oil prices rose Friday on renewed Hormuz uncertainty. Iranian military faction dominates decision-making against concessions. CISA maintains elevated advisory posture. DEFCON 3, nuclear risk 4.

findings.headline: Russia-Ukraine: allies supplied only 1/3 of air defence missiles — Russian strikes escalating on Kyiv
findings.summary: Allies supplied only a third of air defence missiles to Ukraine in 2026 vs 2025. Zelenskiy warns of capability gap as Russia escalates strikes. NATO-Russia closest to direct confrontation since Cold War. Deutsche Bank Research maps August geopolitical risks.

findings.headline: China retaliates against EU sanctions — export bans on 14 European companies
findings.summary: China retaliated against EU sanctions with export bans on 14 European companies. Sanctions proliferation accelerating. Foreign Policy magazine describes current environment as 'new rules of economic warfare.'

findings.headline: Strait of Hormuz disruptions exposing global supply chain risks — ITC warns of trade vulnerability
findings.summary: International Trade Centre warns disruptions to shipping through Strait of Hormuz weighing on global trade. Oil prices rose Friday on renewed Hormuz uncertainty. Iran-Oman talks stalling. Houthis attacking Saudi oil tankers. Strategic realignment of global shipping underway.
findings.source: ITC, Gulf Industry, CNN, Quartz, Logistics Insider

findings.headline: US container imports falling — August volume down 4.2% YoY, peak season winding down
findings.summary: Global Port Tracker projects August at 2.22M TEU, down 4.2% YoY. July at 2.21M TEU, down 7.6% YoY. C.H. Robinson reports service changes, limited allocations, and external disruptions continue. Ocean freight entering August with ongoing disruptions.

findings.headline: Global shipping entering strategic realignment — backup routes rising as main corridors face recurring disruptions
findings.summary: Global shipping entering strategic realignment. System built around speed and low cost now reshaped by recurring disruptions across critical trade corridors. Service changes and limited allocations continue shaping routing options.

findings.headline: CLARITY Act at critical juncture — crypto market structure legislation outcome imminent
findings.summary: CLARITY Act had August 7 Senate deadline. Introduces stability that may decouple crypto from extreme macro volatility by integrating digital assets into federal regulatory perimeter. Senate Democrats demanding tougher ethics provisions. Outcome determines whether US crypto regulation passes in 2026 or slips to 2027.

findings.headline: GENIUS Act in effect — first federal stablecoin framework — Tether/USDC dominate 80%+ market
findings.summary: GENIUS Act established first federal regulatory framework for payment stablecoins. Tether and USDC account for 80%+ of market. Regulatory sandboxes expanding. US crypto regulation being actively rewritten.

findings.headline: Fed payment account rulemaking progressing — BPI urges caution on systemic risk
findings.summary: Federal Reserve rulemaking on payment accounts progressing. BPI warns giving access to firms without deposit insurance could expose financial system to significant risk. Represents regulatory expansion into payment system oversight.

findings.headline: UK FCA cryptoasset regime consultation closes Aug 14 — FCA aims to finalize rules before year end
findings.summary: UK FCA cryptoasset regime consultation closes August 14. FCA aims to finalise rules before year end. Canada CIRO harmonization continuing. Bill C-22 (Lawful Access Act) returns to Senate Sept 21. Global regulatory tightening continues.

findings.headline: US protests rising in 2026 — economic pressure, political division, and global uncertainty driving unrest
findings.summary: Surge in protests across the United States in 2026 driven by economic pressure, political division, global uncertainty, and evolving social movements. Combines with bank money laundering disclosure tied to president's family — political instability vector adding to economic stress.

findings.headline: Indonesia third wave of protests imminent — 250% tax increase, up to 100,000 protesters expected Aug 10-13
findings.summary: Third wave of protests erupting in Indonesia around August 10-13, triggered by 250% increase in land and building taxes. Up to 100,000 protesters expected. Students joining. Imminent this weekend.
findings.source: Wikipedia, Gen Z Protests in Asia

findings.headline: Flamingo Revolution in Albania — media capture and political influence driving protests
findings.summary: Albania's Flamingo Revolution protests driven by media capture concerns. Albania ranked 83rd of 180 in 2026 Press Freedom Index. Civil unrest persisting in Balkans.

findings.headline: Nepal communal clashes — Siraha district security deployment continues
findings.summary: Communal clashes in Nepal's Siraha district. Security deployment continues. Civil instability in South Asian democracies widening.

findings.headline: US economy unexpectedly LOST 23,000 jobs in July — unemployment at 4.1%, hiring turned negative
findings.summary: BLS reports US economy shed 23,000 jobs in July — unexpected decline. Unemployment at 4.1%, dip attributed to declining labor force participation. Healthcare added only 22,000 (slowdown from 36,000 avg). Sahm Rule at 0.07 (below 0.50 trigger) but Lead-Lag Report warns 'correct reading of Sahm, wrong conclusion' — structural labor market deterioration. US News: rising delinquencies and slowing job growth compounding stressed consumer.
findings.source: BLS, CNBC, USA Today, Fox Business, Lead-Lag Report

findings.headline: Yen carry trade unwind threatens global liquidity — 'tinder is there in 2026' per Business Insider
findings.summary: Business Insider quotes analysts: 'coordinated intervention can succeed but needs catalyst of large unwinding of JPY-funded carry trades. The tinder is there in 2026.' Japanese investors repatriating capital. Bitcoin fell 2%+ on intervention. Analysts warn Bitcoin could reach $50,000 if Clarity Act fails and carry trade unwind begins. VT Markets: potential liquidity squeeze from yen carry trade unwind.
findings.source: Business Insider, CoinDesk, VT Markets, FXStreet, BeInCrypto

findings.headline: US GDP slowed to 1.5% in Q2 2026 — recession risk 'still alive' as economy slows
findings.summary: BEA shows US economy expanded at 1.5% annual rate in Q2 2026. Slower growth, elevated inflation, weak hiring keeping recession risks alive. WSJ survey: 25% recession probability. Average new mortgage rates exceed 6.5%. JP Morgan mid-year outlook flags 'promise and pressure.' July jobs report showing negative employment intensifies recession risk.
findings.source: BEA, US News, US Bank, JP Morgan

findings.headline: China real estate at 21-year lows — prices down 22.5% from peak, 70 million jobless, industries collapsing
findings.summary: China existing home prices fallen 22.5% from 2021 peak. Real home prices at lowest in 21 years per BIS data. Real estate supports 50+ related sectors — 70 million jobless as entire industries collapse. Ten straight quarters of deflation. Xi Jinping not mentioning the bust. Leadership ignoring citizen wealth erosion.
findings.source: The Tribune, The Deep Dive, Investment Watch, US Bank

findings.headline: ESM: Euro area growth at 0.1% in adverse scenario — energy-intensive economies face recession if blockade persists
findings.summary: ESM adverse scenario: growth drops to 0.1%, inflation rises to 3.6% in 2026-2027. ESM forecast: GDP growth 1.1% for 2026. Economic impact of 2026 Iran war pushing Europe toward technical recession by end of 2026. UK worst hit by war-induced bond sell-off. ECB warns risks to growth outlook are to the downside.
